headline: Higher Yields Weigh on AI Stock Bull Market as Bond Markets Scrutinize Capex
summary: Rising bond yields are weighing on artificial intelligence stocks as bond markets increasingly scrutinize high corporate capital expenditures.
why: Elevated yields increase borrowing costs and reduce the present value of future cash flows, putting pressure on growth-heavy sectors like artificial intelligence and technology.

impacts.name: US Treasury Yields
impacts.why: Higher yields put downward pressure on long-duration technology equities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Rising borrowing costs and heightened bond market scrutiny over heavy artificial intelligence investments negatively impacted high-valuation tech equities.
